units.source_text: 没下完的棋，由黑子中途暂停，这是传统的习惯，是对高手的礼让。

en.t: In an unfinished game, it was the traditional custom for Black to suspend play midway; this was a courtesy shown to the stronger player.
In this way, the stronger player gained an advantage.

units.source_text: 最近为了防止出现这种不公平的现象，改变了做法，

en.t: Recently, in order to prevent this kind of unfair situation from occurring, the procedure was changed,

units.source_text: 比如谈定下到傍晚五点，时间一到，

en.t: for example, if it had been agreed to play until five in the evening, then when that time arrived,

units.source_text: 轮到谁下就由谁来中途暂停。

en.t: whoever's turn it was to move would be the one to suspend play.

units.source_text: 后来为了进一步推行这种做法，想出了中途封盘这一招。

en.t: Later, to carry this practice further, they devised the method of sealing the next move during the adjournment.

units.source_text: 将棋最早使用这种封盘办法，其后围棋也效法了。

en.t: Shogi was the first to use this sealed-move method, and go later followed its example.

units.source_text: 这种规则是为了尽可能减少不合理的现象，最后才采用的。

en.t: This rule was eventually adopted in order to reduce unreasonable situations as much as possible.

units.source_text: 所谓不合理现象就是看了对手的子，

en.t: The so-called unreasonable situation was that, after seeing the opponent's move,

units.source_text: 自己接着下的子就可以慢慢考虑，直到续弈那天；

en.t: one could then take one's time thinking about one's own next move until the day play resumed;

units.source_text: 而且不管相隔一天还是几天，都不计算在限时之内。

en.t: moreover, whether the interval was one day or several days, that time was not counted against the time limit.
